edges.reason: tx.origin is assigned to the governance state variable in the ERC20 constructor, creating a tx.origin authorization dependency.
The ERC20 constructor reads tx.origin to derive the governance account.
Contract constructor writes the tx.origin-derived value into governance.
governance is used as the trusted reference inside the require(msg.sender == governance) check.
The caller msg.sender is the value compared against governance, controlling the branch outcome.
The governance check gates execution of transferFromAndCall.
transferFromAndCall executes the privileged minting operation after passing its access check.
The minting operation delegates to the internal _mint function.
_mint adds to _totalSupply using SafeMath arithmetic.
_mint adds the minted amount to the recipient balance in _balances.
ERC20.transfer delegates token movement to _transfer.
ERC20.transferFrom delegates token movement to _transfer.
_transfer subtracts and adds amounts in the _balances mapping.
transferAndCallData performs a token transfer and then invokes the recipient callback via _checkAndCallTransfer.
transferFromAndCallData performs a transferFrom and then invokes the recipient callback via _checkAndCallTransfer.
_checkAndCallTransfer makes an external onTransferReceived call to an untrusted contract.
approveAndCallData sets an allowance and then invokes the spender callback via _checkAndCallApprove.
_checkAndCallApprove makes an external onApprovalReceived call to an untrusted contract.
fromAddress is the recipient used by transferFromAndCall when calling minting logic.
SubstractedValue is the mint amount used by transferFromAndCall, affecting total supply.
The name parameter is stored by the ERC20 constructor into _name.
The symbol parameter is stored by the ERC20 constructor into _symbol.
The decimals parameter is applied to the token configuration in the constructor chain.
The cap parameter is forwarded to ERC20Capped, limiting total supply.
